disputes.a: GameTrek and GameMapa list it as Silver, from the official list released 19 Nov 2026.
disputes.b: Push Square lists it as Bronze.
disputes.call: This guide follows the official-list grade (Silver). The trophy itself is unaffected — only the grade label is disputed.
disputes.title: Maximum Withdrawal grade — Silver or Bronze?

disputes.a: Push Square, GameMapa and GTA BOOM number the story chapters 1–4 for these four trophies (Paradise Lost = Chapter 1).
disputes.call: The trophy order is identical under either numbering. This guide follows the majority (Chapters 1–4) and shows the order, not just the number.
disputes.title: Chapter numbering — 4 chapters or 5?

disputes.a: GameTrek calls Positive Mental Attitude the only missable trophy: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
disputes.b: PowerPyx (via GameMapa) has not confirmed whether the trophy needs the balcony meditation at all.
disputes.call: Do it anyway in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. That covers both versions of the truth at zero cost.
disputes.title: Balcony meditation — required or not?

notes: Finish Gone Fishing, then Chapter 1 (Paradise Lost) and Chapter 2 (T**s Ass Drug Money).
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends — the one possibly missable moment (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Start Kenton's shipwrecks (Chapter 1) and Billy's Mudclub quests (Chapter 2) as they open.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay. [3]
stages.summary: Play the opening and the first two chapters in order. Bank the first story trophies, start the earliest stranger strands, and do the one thing in the whole game that cannot wait.
stages.title: Story, Chapters 1–2

notes: Finish Chapters 3, 4 and 5, then the final mission for the gold story trophy.
Start Andy's (Lucia only), Randy's and Tyrone's (Jason only) strands as soon as they open in Chapter 3.
Complete The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory as they arrive.
Check Touch Pad > Progress for lagging activity counters and catch up as you go.
stages.summary: Play the rest of the story. Three more stranger strands open in Chapter 3 — start them all now, because the cleanup stage is far shorter when they are half done.
stages.title: Story, Chapters 3–5

notes: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal) with your partner nearby for Hot Together.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back for Retail Therapy; rob an armored truck for A Classic Blitz Play.
Rob one illegal operation per gang for Pest Control — and use those raids for Gunslinger.
Launder marked bills as you earn them toward Dime on the Dollar ($250,000).
Steal an airliner at VCIA (Catch Me If You Can) and a tank at Mile Zero (Challenging Tank).
stages.summary: The robbery stage. Vaults, trucks, shops and gang operations — plus the partner trophies that ride on the same wanted levels.
stages.title: Partner & crime

notes: Try all 9 activity types once for Master of None — golf, pool and basketball are the usual stragglers.
Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist) — the skill-hardest trophy alongside Sneakthief.
Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; win 20 different races.
Beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, meditate at all 18 spots.
Train Strength together at the gym for Personal Best.
stages.summary: Try everything once, then master the two skill walls: gold medals at the shooting ranges and drone races at every location.
stages.title: Activities

notes: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (Cunning Stunts) and scan 100 WAiNK locations (You WAiNKer!).
Complete 3 card sets now (Don't Touch My Deck) — the checklist wants 15, so keep going.
Discover 100 vehicles (Whip It Good), clear the map fog (The Goodtime State).
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000, Little Boxes) and register 10 vehicles (On the Spot).
Spend $100,000 across shops (Treat Yo Self) — the garages alone clear it.
stages.summary: The long sweep: stunts, scans, cards, vehicles and property. Fold it into travel instead of leaving it all for the end.
stages.title: Collectibles & exploration

notes: Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range and drone race.
Complete 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Finish the 8th stranger strand for Strangers & Freaks (the checklist does not ask for these).
Reach 500 profile-affecting actions for Actions Speak Louder; avoid the Irredeemable profile.
stages.summary: The checklist appears under Progress > Stats after the story. It is closer to 60% true completion — most side quests are not on it — but every robbery, range, race and Bret quest is.
stages.title: 100% Completion

notes: Try the most likely triggers for the five unconfirmed hidden trophies (see their guides).
Sweep the map for leftover fog, scans and vehicles.
When all 54 others are earned, Vice Got a Price! pops on its own.
stages.summary: Whatever is left, then the Platinum. The five unconfirmed hidden trophies live here — try their most likely triggers in free roam and check the Sources view for updates.
stages.title: Cleanup & Platinum
